request.query:
SELECT 'spans' AS signal, count() AS matching_rows, count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS traces, countIf(status_code = 2) AS errors, countIf(toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.trace.sample_rate']) = 1) AS rate_one
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-09 00:11:11', 'UTC')
  AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
  AND (attributes['mikka.error.code'] = 'trace_acceptance_failed' OR attributes['mikka.error.detail'] = 'controlled_database_failure' OR trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('a13813aa2ce5396caf26d911d8952e95')))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'logs' AS signal, count() AS matching_rows, count(DISTINCT trace_id) AS traces, countIf(severity_text = 'ERROR') AS errors, countIf(toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.trace.sample_rate']) = 1) AS rate_one
FROM logs
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-06 00:00:00', 'UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-09 00:11:11', 'UTC')
  AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
  AND (attributes['mikka.error.code'] = 'trace_acceptance_failed' OR attributes['mikka.error.detail'] = 'controlled_database_failure' OR trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('a13813aa2ce5396caf26d911d8952e95')))
request.predicate: Known prior acceptance trace OR controlled error code OR controlled detail; fixed UTC window
